reason: COMPLEX. What I noticed first was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I live out of a tote and forget pills at home, so one foil packet I can toss in my bag fits my travel weeks. I'd pick the 3-form one over the single form, and the QR batch report is a nice extra, but the sachet is what gets me to try one box.
objection: Only 3 forms when other brands put 8 or 14 in one capsule, so it looks thin to me, and I can't tell if the batch report is real or just a QR on a pretty box.
would_change_my_mind: A reviewer or creator I trust showing the QR report actually opening to a real named lab result for that batch, plus a simple reason why 3 forms is enough.
